body:
Reviewed PR #8 (base 54ae39a → head fcee7c1d): a planning-only change of 14 files (+559/−15) — the relationship epic/writer/parity cards, the uuid planning note, three append-only journals (.ημ/receipts.edn, session-mycology ledger, docs/agile/.events/ledger.edn) and 7 evidence-JSON transcriptions. No source, test, workflow, package or config bytes changed. All 12 full-diff pages were read and assessed; surrounding files (contract card, complete plan note, all three amended cards) were read for cross-checks.

Deterministic evidence: exact head, clean checkout, all 10 gates exit 0 — git diff --check clean, 220 tests/2043 assertions/0 failures twice, lint 0 errors/0 warnings, 4 release builds 0 warnings with nonempty outputs. Green gates treated as tool evidence only.

Confirmed finding (low, non-blocking): docs/notes/uuid-relationship-authoring-plan.md:124 — the added readiness section opens "The preceding paragraph describes PR7's retained frontmatter," but the immediately preceding paragraph (lines 115–120) describes PR1's source-preserving merge and contains no frontmatter content; the retained 5/5/13 frontmatter discussion sits two paragraphs earlier (108–113). The disambiguation therefore misfires and leaves the file's present-tense stale estimate text ("The epic proposes 13 points split 3/5/5," line 43) unqualified, so a planning reader can mistake it for the current proposal. Smallest fix: reword the pointer to name the correct earlier paragraph (and optionally qualify line 43). Frontmatter and the new section itself state the current 8/5/16 proposal correctly.

Everything else verified adversarially: estimate changes (writer 5→8, epic 13→16, parity 5) are consistent across frontmatter, prose breakdowns (3/3/2, 2/2/1), all 5 native ledger events (old/new values and write-ids), receipts records, plan table and JSON readbacks (8/5/16, status incoming); no status transitions; journals are pure appends with prefix arithmetic checking out (27455 + 1135 = 28590); card comment sections verbatim-match their ledger events; the base sha equals PR7's merge sha; the embedded APPROVED verdict is commit-bound to PR7's head and explicitly non-transferring; policy text (done predecessor, ready/todo/in_progress guarded targets, complete reads, shared reservation, post-gate revalidation, visible partial effects, cooperative-only reservation scope) is consistent across plan/writer/parity/receipts.

Non-blocking notes: stale present-tense estimate text at plan-note lines 43/110–113 and the epic Verification section's "changes no existing card" phrasing are pre-existing unchanged lines, not introduced here; external Foresight milestone links referenced by the body were not staged and are not independently verifiable; evidence-JSON historical hashes are operator transcriptions; hosted install used --no-frozen-lockfile (environment, not diff). No test-gap findings — the diff introduces no code branches.

Verdict: COMMENT (one confirmed non-blocking finding; nothing blocking).
